description_en: Modifies the inter-region forwarding mode of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的跨地域转发模式
name: ModifyExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTransitMode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

fields.help_en:
The inter-region forwarding mode of the ECR. Valid values:

ECMP: The load balancing mode.

NearBy: The nearby forwarding mode
fields.help_zh:
专线网关跨域转发模式，取值：
ECMP：负载均衡模式。
NearBy：就近转发模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The region where the ECR instance is deployed
fields.help_zh: 专线网关实例所属的地域
fields.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of inter-region forwarding modes
parameters.name: transit_mode_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without modifying the service resource.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of 200 indicates success. For other values, see the error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the \`ErrMessage\` parameter.

For example, if ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.

False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
